title: pilosella piloselloides subsp. magyarica
intro: Pilosella piloselloides subsp. magyarica, commonly known as a subspecies of the False Rose-of-Sharon, is a flowering plant within the dandelion family. It is used in traditional medicine due to its health benefits, which include treating digestive issues and reducing inflammation. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its ability to stimulate digestion, improve liver function, and act as a diuretic. The bioactive constituents present in Pilosella piloselloides subsp. magyarica include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
